title: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Source-Free Universal Domain Adaptation on Time Series Representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.39810v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Source-Free Universal Domain Adaptation (SF-UniDA) extends Universal Domain Adaptation by removing access to source data at adaptation time while still handling label-set mismatches between domains. Despite growing interest in this setting for image data, no benchmark exists for time series, which are more challenging. We present the first SF-UniDA benchmark on time series. In addition, we provide the first study of pretrained foundation models as feature extractors for time series domain adaptation. In this context, we identify a critical and previously underexplored limitation of all existing SF-UniDA methods: the inference threshold for unknown-sample rejection is highly sensitive. We address this by proposing a plug-in auto-thresholding module that can be integrated into any SF-UniDA method. translated_title: 面向时间序列表示的无源通用域自适应综合基准
translated_abstract: 无源通用域自适应通过在适应阶段移除对源数据的访问，同时仍能处理域间标签集不匹配的问题，从而扩展了通用域自适应。尽管图像数据领域对这一设置的兴趣日益增长，但对于更具挑战性的时间序列数据，目前尚无相关基准。我们提出了首个时间序列上的无源通用域自适应（SF-UniDA）基准。此外，我们还首次研究了预训练基础模型作为时间序列域自适应特征提取器的作用。在此背景下，我们识别出所有现有SF-UniDA方法的一个关键且此前未被充分探索的局限性：用于拒绝未知样本的推理阈值高度敏感。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个可集成到任何SF-UniDA方法中的即插即用自动阈值模块。在三个知名时间序列数据集上的实验证实了该模块的适用性，同时实验还凸显出基础模型并不能……（摘要原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个时间序列无源通用域自适应基准，首次将预训练基础模型用作特征提取器，并揭示了现有方法中未知样本拒绝阈值高度敏感的局限，同时提出可即插即用的自动阈值模块加以解决。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first SF-UniDA benchmark on time series, provides the first study of foundation models as feature extractors, identifies the highly sensitive unknown-sample rejection threshold as a critical limitation of existing methods, and proposes a plug-in auto-thresholding module to address it.
